title: Query Planner
tagline: A browser-based SQL query planner and executor that shows every plan a database considered — not just the one it picked — and puts its estimate next to the truth at every step, so you can see exactly where and why it guessed wrong

metrics.label: Tests, including 33 checked against real Postgres
DP cells for an 8-table join — every losing plan kept, not discarded
Runtime dependencies — no SQL, charting, or graph-layout library
Gzipped bundle, well under its own 350KB budget
